g.text: Rendered evidence from captured output
erver id) and declared skills (namespaced model refs). Addressed by the version id alone — access is membership of the version's o
wn project, and historical versions of uninstalled…\n- [List a project's skills](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/skills/list
-a-projects-skills.md): The Cloud Skills visible to the caller in this project: the project-shared ones plus the caller's own draf
ts. Each row reports `pinnability`, which is what decides whether its id is usable in an environment's `skillSelection`.\n- [Get a
skill](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/skills/get-a-skill.md): One skill, including its SKILL.md body. The body is mutable
and an edit overwrites the previous one in place, so `aggregateHash` is the only handle on which content this read returned.\n- [R
un one headless agent turn](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/agent/run-one-headless-agent-turn.md): Runs ONE assistant turn o
ver the supplied message history and responds synchronously with the final assistant text, the operations it invoked, references t
o any resources it created, and any actions awaiting human approval.\n- [Connect an MCP server](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-refere
nce/server-connections/connect-an-mcp-server.md): Starts a connection request for an MCP server URL. Discovery, browser consent, a
nd validation happen asynchronously; poll the returned `connectionRequestId` until the status is terminal. When the next step belo
ngs to a person, the response carries a `handoffUrl` to open.\n- [Get a connection request](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/
server-connections/get-a-connection-request.md): Current state of one connection request. Metered on its own poll budget rather th
an the shared per-caller one, so polling on a short interval is expected and will not spend the budget your other calls need. A 42
9 here means the poll interval itself is too fast; honour Retry-After.\n- [Cancel a connection request](https://docs.mcpjam.com/ap
i-reference/server-connections/cancel-a-connection-request.md): Stops a request and invalidates its handoff link. Cancelling an al
ready-terminal request is a no-op.\n- [Retry validation](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/server-connections/retry-validation
.md): Re-arms a stalled validation immediately instead of waiting out its backoff. Does not revive a terminal request — after `fai
led`, `expired`, or `cancelled`, start a new one.\n- [List personas](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarms/list-personas.md
): The project's personas, newest first. Archived personas are excluded.\n- [Create a persona](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-referen
ce/swarms/create-a-persona.md): Creates one persona. To draft several with a model first, use `POST /projects/{projectId}/personas
/generate` — that route persists nothing.\n- [Get a persona](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarms/get-a-persona.md): A per
sona that lives in a DIFFERENT project answers 404, never 403 — the route is not an existence oracle for a project you cannot see.
\n- [Delete a persona](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarms/delete-a-persona.md): Refused with 409 while goals still refer
ence this persona — deleting it would strand them.\n- [Update a persona](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarms/update-a-per
sona.md): Partial update. Goals reference the persona by id, so renaming one does not disturb anything pointing at it.\n- [Draft p
ersonas with a model](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarms/draft-personas-with-a-model.md): Returns DRAFTS and persists no
thing. That separation is deliberate: generation is the step most likely to produce something nobody wanted, and a route that both
invented and saved would make \"let me see what you'd suggest\" indistinguishable from \"fill my project with these\".\n- [Draft
journeys for a persona](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarms/draft-journeys-for-a-persona.md): Returns DRAFTS and persists
nothing — see `POST /projects/{projectId}/personas/generate` for why, and for the quota this counts against.\n- [Get a journey](h
ttps://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarms/get-a-journey.md)\n- [Archive a journey](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarms/
archive-a-journey.md): ARCHIVES rather than deletes, and the response says so. Existing runs keep pointing at the definition they
executed, so their history stays readable.\n- [Update a journey](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarms/update-a-journey.md)
: Editing a goal never disturbs a run already under way: a run pins its own immutable snapshot of the definition at launch.\n- [Li
st swarms](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarms/list-swarms.md)\n- [Create a swarm](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/
swarms/create-a-swarm.md): A swarm is an authoring container holding DEFAULTS for the goals made under it. Creating one starts not
hing.\n- [Get a swarm](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarms/get-a-swarm.md)\n- [Archive a swarm](https://docs.mcpjam.com/a
pi-reference/swarms/archive-a-swarm.md): ARCHIVES the container. The goals authored under it are not touched — they keep their own
definitions and stay launchable.\n- [Update a swarm](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarms/update-a-swarm.md): Changes the
container's DEFAULTS. Goals already authored under it keep the values they were created with — this is not a cascade.\n- [List jo
urneys](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarms/list-journeys.md): The project's goals, newest first. Archived goals are excl
uded.\n- [Create a journey](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarms/create-a-journey.md): Creates one goal: a persona pursuin
g a task against one or more environments. To draft several with a model first, use `POST /projects/{projectId}/goals/generate` —
that route persists nothing.\n- [List secrets](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/secrets/list-secrets.md): The project's crede
ntials as METADATA ONLY — no value is returned by this or any other route. Shows the project-shared secrets plus the caller's own
personal ones; another member's personal secret does not appear at all, not even its name.\n- [Create a secret](https://docs.mcpja
m.com/api-reference/secrets/create-a-secret.md): Store a credential so environments can grant it to runs. THE VALUE TRAVELS IN THE
REQUEST BODY and becomes visible to whatever makes the call. The response is metadata only. Creating a project-shared secret requ
ires project admin; a personal one does not.\n- [Get a secret](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/secrets/get-a-secret.md): One
secret's metadata: delivery mode, host binding, sharing, and when it was last handed to a run. Never its value. A secret from ano
ther project — and another member's personal secret — both read as 404.\n- [Delete a secret](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference
/secrets/delete-a-secret.md): Delete a stored credential. HARD — the row and the encrypted value both go, and MCPJam stops deliver
ing it. Deliberately NOT blocked when an environment still selects it: refusing would leave a leaked credential undeletable until
someone edited every environment naming it, and deletion must never wa…\n- [Rotate or re-bind a secret](https://docs.mcpjam.com/ap
i-reference/secrets/rotate-or-re-bind-a-secret.md): Rotate the value and/or change how it is delivered. A rotation reaches NEW RUN
S ONLY: a session already running holds the old value — materialized in its box's environment, or inside an egress policy that can
not be read back — and there is no safe way to replace it mid-run.\n- [List a journey's runs](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-referenc
e/swarm-runs/list-a-journeys-runs.md): Newest first. Compact records — `attempts` is on the single-run read.\n- [Launch a journey]
(https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarm-runs/launch-a-journey.md): Answers **202**: the run row exists and its fan-out has st
arted. It is not finished — poll `GET /projects/{projectId}/goal-runs/{runId}` until `status` leaves `running`.\n- [Get a journey
run](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarm-runs/get-a-journey-run.md): The full record, including per-session `attempts` and
`targetSummaries`.\n- [List a run's sessions](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarm-runs/list-a-runs-sessions.md): One entr
y per chat session the run produced. Summaries, not transcripts — read a transcript through the chat-session routes using `id`.\n-
[Cancel a journey run](https://docs.mcpjam.com/api-reference/swarm-runs/cancel-a-journey-run.md): Accepts a durable Stop request
